Where does the applicant collect mail? At join the node mails a card with a one-time code to a street parcel, first class, then reads the postal record: residential only, no commercial mailbox agency, one parcel one seat, rechecked as tenants move.

Fifty clones need fifty real doors with someone standing behind each. A jade card costs 1.50 dollars in postage and a live address 40 to 80 dollars monthly, so fifty seats cost near 3,000 dollars a month and wait ten days for a code a gale can soak off the porch.

The tide under a rowboat was set by the moon before the oar went in.
